grid_posture.dno: Multiple UKPN/WPD sites — Slough/West London cluster

risk_manifestation.headline: Lawful curtailment — no damage trigger
risk_manifestation.mechanism: AWS cites multi-year grid-connection lead times versus two-year build cycles — non-firm or delayed firm access is a disclosed planning risk across European campuses.
risk_manifestation.insured_today: Standard PD/BI wordings do not respond — curtailment is not a proximate physical-damage event (LMA BI guidance).

risk_manifestation.headline: One node, correlated loss
risk_manifestation.mechanism: All capacity sits behind Slough–West London grid-constrained data-centre hub; correlated curtailment or outage hits the full insured value stack.
risk_manifestation.insured_today: Property cat aggregates at site; grid-system curtailment correlation rarely priced.

inferred_typical.basis: Typical asset stack; no published schedule for this entity
